rows.title: lead scoring policy handling procedure
rows.body: [SUPERSEDED 2025] lead scoring policy records verified in status "active" must be moved to status "pending". This document may be outdated.

rows.title: lead scoring policy handling procedure (rev. 2)
rows.body: [CURRENT — effective 2026-06-01, supersedes all prior versions] For lead scoring policy records verified in status "active": if the record's created_at is "2024-09-12", move it to status "inactive"; otherwise move it to status "pending". Apply exactly one transition.

rows.title: lead scoring policy handling procedure
rows.body: [SUPERSEDED 2025] lead scoring policy records verified in status "inactive" must be moved to status "active". This document may be outdated.

rows.title: lead scoring policy handling procedure (rev. 2)
rows.body: [CURRENT — effective 2026-06-01, supersedes all prior versions] For lead scoring policy records verified in status "inactive": if the record's created_at is "2024-02-02", move it to status "pending"; otherwise move it to status "active". Apply exactly one transition.
